purpose: Expose a keyboard-focusable named region with native overflow scrolling and an optional maximum height.
behaviorProvider: Native div overflow scrolling; no custom scrollbar or virtualization engine.

requirements.statement: Render role=region with label as its accessible name, defaulting to Scrollable content; these semantic props override forwarded role, aria-label and tabIndex.
Set tabIndex=0 so the native scroll region can receive keyboard focus without changing descendant tab order.
Use overflow:auto and overscroll-behavior:contain in owned CSS, allowing native scrolling on either overflowing axis.
Default maxHeight to the owning component token; merge a supplied style after maxHeight so a host style.maxHeight can deliberately override it.
Forward remaining native div attributes and event handlers; native browser scrolling, selection and keyboard defaults remain available unless the host overrides them.
Supply a specific region label when more than one scroll area exists or the generic default does not identify its content.
Provide appropriate dimensions and content widths. A maximum height alone does not impose a fixed height or automatically reserve application viewport space.
Own virtualization, loading, restoration of scroll position and movement to selected items or errors. Preserve meaningful focus order in any content rendered inside.
Own pattern or component styling consumes layout group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No virtualization, custom scrollbars, scroll persistence, selected-item reveal or loading lifecycle.
The region is focusable even when its current content does not overflow.
Native scrolling behavior and assistive technology handling vary by platform.
